description: Debugging tool for SO-100/SO-101 servo problems: servos not responding and small jerky movements

userStories.title: Create diagnostic script for USB port detection
userStories.description: As a user, I need to identify if my USB ports are detected and accessible so I can rule out connection issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Script lists all available serial ports on Linux/Mac
Checks if udev rules are set correctly (Linux)
Outputs clear pass/fail status for each check
userStories.notes: src/port_scanner.py. Also checks ModemManager, brltty rules for WCH 1a86, the vendor ch343 driver, /dev/serial/by-id names and the VS Code Flatpak sandbox. Writes no udev rule itself (needs sudo); prints one.

userStories.title: Create motor bus connection tester
userStories.description: As a user, I need to test if the motor bus can establish communication so I know the controller board works.
userStories.notes: src/bus_tester.py. Scans all 8 STS baudrates (not just 115200/1000000) and IDs 0-20 (or 0-252 with --full); reports duplicate IDs as garbled replies.

userStories.title: Create individual motor ping utility
userStories.description: As a user, I need to ping each motor individually to identify which specific motors are failing.
acceptanceCriteria: Pings each motor ID (1-6 for SO-101)
Reports response time for each motor
Suggests possible causes (bad ID, power, cable)
userStories.notes: src/motor_ping.py. Locates where the daisy chain breaks (board -> 1 -> ... -> 6).

userStories.title: Create power supply diagnostics
userStories.description: As a user, I need to verify power supply status as insufficient power causes servo failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads voltage from motors that respond
userStories.notes: src/power_diagnostics.py. Changed from 'warn below 11V': the standard SO-101 is 7.4 V motors on a 5 V supply. Classifies the motor by Max_Voltage_Limit (14.0 V = 12 V motor) and flags a supply above the motor's limit as CRITICAL. Monitor for drop-outs; load test moves one joint to catch brownouts (below 4.8 V on 7.4 V motors).

userStories.title: Create motor reset and reconfiguration tool
userStories.description: As a user, I need to reset and reconfigure motors with correct settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Sets correct ID for each motor position
Sets operating mode to position control
userStories.notes: src/motor_reset.py. No factory reset on purpose: it clears ID and baudrate. Sets ID/baud of the single connected motor; writes LeRobot's configure() values (P/I/D 16/0/32, gripper limits). Torque left off.

userStories.title: Create automated diagnostic report generator
userStories.description: As a user, I want a comprehensive diagnostic report summarizing all issues found.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs all diagnostic checks in sequence
userStories.notes: src/report_generator.py. Writes diagnostics/report.md and a timestamped copy.

userStories.title: Create interactive CLI debugger
userStories.description: As a user, I want an interactive CLI to walk through debugging steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Options: Port scan, Motor scan, Ping test, Reset motor, Full diagnostic

userStories.title: Create motor settings audit
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see stored servo settings that cause buzzing or stepwise motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads operating mode, P/I/D, Max_Torque_Limit, Return_Delay_Time, limits, Phase
Flags PID not 16/0/32 and torque limit below 800

userStories.title: Create bus reliability test
userStories.description: As a user, I want to know if bus reads fail under teleop-like load.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads every joint's position back to back for N seconds
Reports loop rate and failed-cycle share per joint

userStories.title: Check LeRobot install and calibration
userStories.description: As a user, I want old LeRobot builds and stale calibration flagged, since both cause jerky motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Warns below 0.6.0 (position overflow) and 0.6.1 (no read retries)
Flags calibration made before the fixes or with empty ranges

userStories.title: Test without hardware
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the checks tested without the arm.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulated Feetech bus with voltage limits, EEPROM lock, duplicate IDs, brownouts
